claims.text: PROTOCOL.md specifies 720 runs by pooling 24 dev and 24 held-out cases; the held-out denominator must be corrected to 24 cases, with minimum recommended pilot 120 and held-out 120.

EVALUATION_SPEC.md asserts double-blind evaluation and treats repeated trials as independent; agents observe condition prompts, so blinding applies only to assessors, and repeated trials are clustered.
Section 5 of manuscript remains pending; no empirical execution or gold labels exist before freeze.
Related work descriptions of Adaptive-RAG (cannot adapt), Reflexion (strictly scalar oracle), and STORM (static/no trajectory) overstate absence of capability compared to primary sources.

lenses.label: Protocol & Design Rigor
lenses.rationale: Verify benchmark partitioning, trial count independence, and blinding terminology.

lenses.label: Primary Literature Fidelity
lenses.rationale: Verify accuracy of related work comparative characterizations against primary sources.

gaps.question: Does the 720-run matrix dilute the held-out benchmark by including 24 dev cases, and what is the minimum approved execution plan?
gaps.whyItMatters: Mixing dev cases into held-out evaluation corrupts pre-registration boundary and inflates execution budget.

gaps.question: Is the double-blind designation justified, and are repeated trials on the same case erroneously treated as independent units?
gaps.whyItMatters: Unjustified blinding claims and pseudo-replication undermine scientific validity of statistical tests.

gaps.question: Do the primary papers of Adaptive-RAG, Reflexion, and STORM contradict the sweeping negative assertions in manuscript-ja.md?
gaps.whyItMatters: Misrepresenting prior work undermines paper credibility and violates working rules.

gaps.question: Are empirical evaluation results, full monetary costs, and open-web generalisation measured and validated?
gaps.whyItMatters: Empirical metrics, monetary costs, and generalisation cannot be resolved prior to authorised experiment execution.

probes.question: Check PROTOCOL.md run counts against the 24 dev / 24 held-out partition to establish the correct held-out denominator and minimum run count.
probes.successCondition: Held-out denominator is corrected to 24, with pilot 24x5x1=120 and held-out 24x5x1=120 as the recommended minimum plan.
probes.refutationCondition: Protocol already isolates held-out runs to 24 cases without unapproved expansion.
probes.inconclusiveCondition: Protocol text is ambiguous or contradictory.

probes.question: Audit blinding definition and trial independence assumptions in EVALUATION_SPEC.md.
probes.successCondition: Blinding is corrected to single-blind assessor grading; repeated trials are noted as clustered within cases requiring case-level exact McNemar tests.
probes.refutationCondition: Agents are genuinely blinded to prompts and repeated runs are independent.

probes.question: Compare manuscript statements with primary arXiv papers: does Adaptive-RAG have multi-step iterative retrieval, does Reflexion have trajectory reflection, does STORM have conversational search trajectories?
probes.successCondition: Primary sources confirm that statements overstate absence, necessitating concrete text corrections.
probes.refutationCondition: Manuscript statements perfectly align with primary text.
